title: Bengaluru special court rejects Priyank Kharge’s claim that RSS member can’t file defamation case as it is not a registered organisation
description: Various courts have declared that ‘the RSS is a definite, determinate, and identifiable body or class of persons; and consequently, where defamatory imputations are made against the RSS as an organisation, an individual member of the RSS is competent to maintain a complaint for defamation’
